items.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
items.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
items.author: thedotmack
items.summary_zh: claude-mem 是 GitHub 上的一个开源项目，它会把 agent 在一次会话中做的所有操作记录下来，用 AI 压缩后把相关上下文重新注入之后的会话，让上下文跨会话延续。据项目描述，它可以和 Claude 配合使用，适合那些要跑多轮长任务、不想每次重新交代背景的开发者。
items.summary_en: claude-mem is a GitHub project that records everything an agent does during a session, compresses that history with AI, and injects the relevant parts back into later sessions so context carries over between runs. Its description says it works with Claude, which makes it relevant to developers running long, multi-session tasks who don't want to re-explain the background each time.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 文章拆解 2026 年技术面试里的高频问题，作者在技术社群收集到「给你一个实习生加 Claude Code 能替代你吗」等至少三种问法，并分析「AI 代码质量不行」「AI 不理解业务」这类回答为何已经失效。他给出的答法分两层：AI 写代码而人做决策，AI 能写一个文件而人能设计系统，并举电商倒计时组件说明 AI 不会主动追问本地时间被篡改、并发归零等边界问题。
items.summary_en: A Chinese engineering post breaks down a question now common in 2026 interviews, including the variant "if I gave you an intern plus Claude Code, could they replace you?", and explains why stock answers such as "AI code quality is bad" no longer land. The author's own answer has two layers: AI writes code while humans make decisions, and AI writes one file while humans design a system, illustrated by an e-commerce countdown component whose edge cases the model never raises on its own.

items.title: 谷歌推出 EnvHarness，支持自进化智能体动态环境学习
items.summary_zh: 谷歌研究人员开源了 EnvHarness：不改动智能体、环境或评估系统，只在中间加一层封装，就能按智能体的短板动态调整训练环境。它用标准 reset()/step() 接口包裹静态环境，以 setup、rule、link 三种可组合组件调整初始状态、状态转移和观测；配套的 EnvRigger 会分析运行轨迹、定位反复出现的薄弱点并生成针对性改动。论文称在 WebArena、SWE-bench Verified 等基准上，多个模型提升 2.9 到 3.7 个百分点。
items.summary_en: Google researchers have open-sourced EnvHarness, a framework that reshapes an agent's training environment around its weak spots without touching the agent, the environment or the evaluation system. It wraps existing environments behind the standard reset() and step() interfaces using three composable parts — setup, rule and link — while a companion loop, EnvRigger, spots recurring failures in agent trajectories and writes targeted tweaks. The paper reports 2.9 to 3.7 percentage point gains on WebArena, SWE-bench Verified and other benchmarks.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 作者记录自己从 2025 年 4 月起使用 Cursor、到 2026 年 4 月因公司把中国区从 Cursor 换成 OpenAI Codex 后的大半个月体验。他认为 Cursor 的长处是贴着编码现场的 Tab 补全、Cmd+K、Agent 与 Plan Mode，而 Codex 更像一个能独立推进任务的超级 Agent，更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_en: A developer recounts moving from Cursor, which he used from April 2025, first self-paid at $20 a month and later on a company enterprise plan, to OpenAI Codex after his company shifted its China region off Cursor when pricing changed from fixed licenses to usage-based billing in April 2026. Cursor, he argues, excelled at staying inside the editor with Tab completion, Cmd+K and Plan Mode, whereas Codex feels less like an IDE assistant and more like an autonomous agent that can carry a task on its own.

items.summary_en: Deheng Ye, a former partner in Tencent AI Lab's R4 division and technical lead of the Honor of Kings "Juewu" game AI, has confirmed on his personal homepage that he is now a researcher at ByteDance Seed working on foundation models. He was at Tencent from 2017 to 2026, leaving before Tencent formally announced the lab's dissolution. His page also lists an undisclosed SeedXxx model and agent systems including ui-voyager, omni-reasoner and proact — a concrete data point for anyone tracking RL and game-AI talent moving into foundation-model teams in China.

items.title: Chainguard 推出面向 AI 编码智能体的安全工作区与安全校验能力
items.summary_zh: Chainguard 发布测试版 Workspaces 与 Checks：前者为每位开发者或智能体分配一台加固微型虚拟机作为远程开发环境，可同步未提交改动，并在断开后恢复文件、进程与 shell 上下文；后者在预热好的微型虚拟机中运行 CI 步骤，可通过命令行、提交前钩子或 GitHub 应用调用。两者配合时，失败的检查把结构化日志送回会话，成功的运行生成绑定环境与 commit SHA 的签名证明，合并关卡据此校验而无需重跑测试。两款产品在伦敦 Assemble 大会上公布，意在降低智能体装包执行时凭证外泄与提示词注入的风险。
items.summary_en: Chainguard has launched beta versions of Workspaces, a remote dev environment that gives each developer or coding agent its own hardened microVM with session snapshots restoring files, processes and shell context, and Checks, which runs CI steps in pre-warmed microVMs callable via CLI, pre-commit hooks or a GitHub app. Announced at the company's Assemble conference in London, the pair is meant to curb credential exposure and prompt-injection fallout when agents install packages and run commands. Used together, failed checks return structured logs to the resumed session, while passing runs produce a signed attestation binding environment, verdict and commit SHA.

items.summary_en: At the 1024 ModelWorks AI Community Day, Bi Xuan, founder and CEO of Beilian Zhuguan, used his team's SREAgent — an AI assistant that reads monitoring data and logs to help enterprises troubleshoot IT systems — to argue that vertical agents cannot win on long-running tasks or fluent tool use, since models are absorbing those abilities. The durable moat, he says, is wiring up each customer's messy monitoring and log sources and building domain models that keep evolving with the business. SREAgent 3.0 lets customers generate Skills from natural-language requests.

items.summary_zh: InfoQ 教程用四条提示词，在 Hex Agent 中连接 Snowflake 上的 Amazon Best Sellers 评论数据集（2,700 款产品、25.6 万条评论），对 3.7 星的 GE Profile Opal 2.0 制冰机的 98 条评论做情感分析与投诉主题分类，20 分钟内做出并发布应用。案例说明平均星级会掩盖黑霉、退货与安全隐患等两极分化反馈，适合想把用户评论变成产品决策依据的团队。
items.summary_en: An InfoQ tutorial shows how four prompts in Hex Agent, connected to an Amazon Best Sellers review dataset on Snowflake covering 2,700 products and 256,000 reviews, turn 98 reviews of the 3.7-star GE Profile Opal 2.0 ice maker into sentiment scores and complaint categories, going from blank page to published app in under 20 minutes. The case shows how an average rating hides polarized feedback such as mold, returns and safety complaints, useful for teams that want to turn customer reviews into product decisions.

items.summary_en: Cisco president and chief product officer Jeetu Patel handed a 27-year-old, Padmanabhan Krishnamurthy — a former AI startup CEO whose company Cisco acquired — the job of rewriting 98% of Cisco's legacy code with just two people, an unlimited AI token budget and a 24-month target that starts with a four-week validation. Fortune reported the story on October 30; Cisco has not disclosed progress, scope or tooling. The real question is how AI coding reshapes engineering orgs at large enterprises.

items.title: EmbeddingGemma 2：Google 把五种模态塞进同一个向量空间
items.summary_zh: Google 发布 EmbeddingGemma 2，这是基于 Gemma 4、以 Apache 2.0 许可发布的开放权重多模态嵌入模型，把文本、代码、图像、视频和音频放进同一个 768 维向量空间，可按需只加载部分编码器，参数量从 2.7 亿到 7.4 亿，并针对设备端部署做过优化。它支持 MRL 截断：100 万个 768 维向量约需 1.5GB 内存，截到 128 维只需 250MB，代价是图像、视频和语音检索质量降到约 75%。适合做端侧搜索、RAG 与跨媒体检索的开发者。
items.summary_en: Google released EmbeddingGemma 2, an Apache 2.0 open-weight multimodal embedding model built on Gemma 4 that maps text, code, images, video and audio into a single 768-dimensional space, letting developers load only the encoders they need, with parameter counts from 270M to 740M and tuning for on-device deployment. Matryoshka truncation cuts a million 768-dim vectors from about 1.5GB to 250MB at 128 dimensions, though image, video and audio retrieval quality falls to roughly 75%. Aimed at local search, RAG and cross-media retrieval.

items.summary_zh: 极客邦科技创始人兼 CEO 霍太稳在 1024 模力工场·AI 社区日上介绍「模力工场」：用 AI 估算项目所需的时间和预算，按技术团队过往的交付表现推荐合作方，合作后再跟进交付、评估结果，想补上企业找不到靠谱团队、团队又担心收不到钱之间的信任缺口。他同时宣布极客邦科技南方总部与 TGO 鲲鹏会全球总部落户杭州，并提到企业需求正从几天培训转向让服务方带团队做出可用的智能体与 Skill。
items.summary_en: At the 1024 模力工场 AI community day, 极客邦科技 founder and CEO 霍太稳 introduced 模力工场, a platform that uses AI to estimate a project's time and budget, recommend delivery teams based on their past performance, and then track delivery and evaluate results — targeting the trust gap between companies that can't find reliable teams and teams that fear not getting paid. He also announced that 极客邦's southern headquarters and TGO's global headquarters are settling in Hangzhou, and noted enterprises now want vendors to build working agents and Skills with their teams rather than sit through multi-day training.

items.title: [程序员] 我在 2 核 2G 云主机上跑 OpenViking：一次关于云主机、模型选型与长期成本的真实复盘
items.summary_zh: 开发者把 AI Coding Agent 的记忆底座迁到自建 OpenViking，在阿里云 99 元/年的 2 核 2G 云主机上跑通了：用 Swap 兜底、限制容器内存、推理全交给外部 API。他不选更便宜的友商 4G 促销机，是看中续费不涨价，记忆库不必跨云搬家；向量模型也坚持一步到位，因为换模型要全库重建索引，所以放弃了免费的 BGE-M3。
items.summary_en: A developer moved the memory layer of his AI coding agent onto self-hosted OpenViking and reports it runs fine on a 99-yuan-per-year Alibaba Cloud instance with 2 vCPUs and 2GB RAM, using swap, container memory caps and external APIs for all inference. He skipped cheaper 4GB promo boxes because renewal prices stay flat and his memory store avoids cross-cloud migrations, and argues the embedding model must be picked once, since switching forces a full re-index.

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable

items.summary_zh: impeccable 是一套给 coding agent 用的设计词汇表：用 npx impeccable install 安装、在 agent 里运行 /impeccable init 之后，就能用 polish、bolder、critique、audit 等命令调整和审查界面产出，在代码上线前拦掉 AI 味的同质化设计。它支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex CLI、GitHub Copilot、Gemini CLI 等十余种工具，适合在意 UI 质感的开发者。
items.summary_en: Impeccable is a design vocabulary for coding agents: install it with npx impeccable install, run /impeccable init inside your agent, and you get commands like polish, bolder, critique and audit to steer and review UI output, catching formulaic AI-generated design before it ships. items.title: [程序员] 压缩的尽头是自指？从 LZMA2、PAQ8PX 到 zstd/ZIP/RAR Quine，我折腾了一遍“自包含压缩包”
items.summary_zh: 博主在 16MiB 数据上实测 LZMA2、ZPAQ、PAQ8PX、NNCP、cmix 等压缩器：PAQ8PX 压到约 3.1MiB，但要一个半小时和 30GiB 内存；Fabrice Bellard 的 Transformer 压缩器 NNCP 在 RTX 4090 上只得到 4.1MiB，输给 7-Zip 的 LZMA2；cmix 中途崩溃。后半篇还附上 zstd、ZIP 两种 Quine 自包含压缩包的生成代码，适合关心压缩格式底层实现的人。
items.summary_en: A developer benchmarked several compressors on a 16MiB corpus: PAQ8PX reached about 3.1MiB but needed 1.5 hours and roughly 30GiB of RAM, while NNCP — Fabrice Bellard's Transformer-based compressor — landed at 4.1MiB on an RTX 4090, worse than 7-Zip's LZMA2; cmix crashed midway. The second half builds self-contained quine archives in zstd and ZIP, generator code included, for anyone curious about format internals.

With full access enabled it writes frontend and backend in one task — backend work landed well, frontend UI fidelity still needed manual touch-ups. It reveals how unstable LLM self-identity can be and reminds developers that system prompts heavily shape output boundaries.

items.title: 基于 Pi，我居然自己搞了一个好用的 AI Agent 桌面工作台
items.description: 先说结论：别重复造轮子 很多人一听"自己开发 Agent"，第一反应是"那不得从模型调用、消息循环、工具协议、权限系统一路手写？"。 其实不用。Ag
items.summary_zh: Tether 是一个 MIT 协议的 AI 编程桌面工作台，用 Electron 37 + React 19 + TypeScript 5.9 搭建，配置、凭据与会话都存在本机 ~/.tether，模型请求直连用户自己配置的服务商或本地网关，不经中转。它没有重写 Agent 基础设施：Agent 循环、模型协议与工具调用来自开源 Pi 生态，由 tether-agent-core 补充权限模型、沙箱、文件 Checkpoint、MCP 与 Hooks；渲染进程关闭 nodeIntegration 并开启 sandbox，Agent 跑在通过 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 启动的独立子进程里。适合想看桌面端 Agent 进程隔离与 IPC 契约怎么设计的开发者。
items.summary_en: Tether is an MIT-licensed AI coding desktop workbench built on Electron 37, React 19 and TypeScript 5.9, storing config, credentials and sessions locally under ~/.tether and sending model requests straight to a user-configured provider or local gateway with no relay in between. It avoids rebuilding agent infrastructure: the agent loop, model protocol and tool calls come from the open-source Pi ecosystem, while tether-agent-core adds permissions, sandboxing, file checkpoints, MCP and hooks; the renderer runs sandboxed without nodeIntegration and the agent lives in a separate subprocess launched via ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE. Relevant to anyone designing process isolation and IPC contracts for desktop agents.

items.description: Claude 被迫戒断之后，我认真地在思考一个问题： 如果所有国外的模型不能用了，那么我应该怎么应对？ 我常常听到这样的论调：时至今日，没必要去搞什么 Claude，国产模型也不差。 这句话有一定道理

items.summary_en: After losing access to Claude, the author asked Zhipu's GLM5.3 to clone the animated particle landing page of a G4 release: it ran 58 minutes and botched the central element, while GLM5.3-Flash took 1 hour 42 minutes for a passable but generic imitation. The same task took GPT-6.1 Sol five minutes and Gemini 4 Argon nine, and Opus 5.5 also delivered, each adding extras like pause and replay, color modes, or draggable parameters. A concrete side-by-side of front-end cloning ability.
